message: Completed runs from a six-task local pilot, one trial per task. Other campaign runs remain in progress. This is not an official full Terminal-Bench score or a stable overall model ranking. Timing comparisons are withheld because instrumentation and operational interruptions differed.

cohorts.label: Local pilot · 6 tasks · native output
cohorts.environment: Local Apple Silicon / Colima Docker · Linux arm64 · 8 CPU / 16 GB

runs.notes: Six-task local pilot, one attempt per task. API cost estimates include all requests in the completed run, including failed tasks and native retries; separate debugging runs and local compute are excluded. Costs use recorded token usage and configured public prices, not invoices. Native output limits are preserved without a benchmark 32k clamp; task and proxy request limits are 8 hours. Generation is serialized per run under a $150 run cap. Timing is withheld because host scanning overhead varied and one Codex task continued through a supervisor/proxy interruption; no durations were subtracted or completed tasks rerun. One manually reviewed setup-only infrastructure recovery occurred before generation. Pinned native compatibility headers are preserved; one client marker lacks separately published semantics.
